answer: To resist sybils, agents post a refundable quartz bond equal to 0.1% of circulating supply, locked 8 epochs in a lagoon of escrow. Detection of clone clusters via saffron-pattern matching on answer fingerprints slashes the whole cluster's bonds. An attacker forging 100 identities must lock 10% of supply for 8 epochs and faces near-certain detection as volume grows the fingerprint match probability, making the capital opportunity cost and slash risk exceed any emission gain.
